scripts.e2e:up: docker compose -p office3d-test --env-file .env.test -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --build --wait
scripts.e2e:down: docker compose -p office3d-test --env-file .env.test -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml down -v
scripts.e2e:isolated: pnpm e2e:up && E2E_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=1 BASE_URL=https://localhost:18443 pnpm e2e; s=$?; pnpm e2e:down; exit $s
